5	/// `EntryDetailScreen`'s own sealed state (spec-4-4, Code Map) — mirrors
6	/// `MeusRegistrosState`'s shape (a loading/resolved/empty-ish/error split),
7	/// never the shared `Resource<T>` (same exclusion rationale
8	/// `MeusRegistrosState`'s own doc already gives): this screen's one-shot
9	/// fetch still has its own distinct "not found" outcome `Resource<T>`
10	/// doesn't model.
11	///
12	/// [sessionStatus] carries `EntryDetailCubit`'s own composed
13	/// `SessionRepository.statusStream` snapshot (Boundaries, Acceptance
14	/// Criteria's third bullet: "combines ... into its own sealed
15	/// `EntryDetailState`") — review fix (round 2): previously held only as a
16	/// side field on the cubit, outside this sealed type. [sessionStatus]
17	/// participates in every variant's `==`/`hashCode` below *on purpose*: a
18	/// `Cubit` skips `emit` entirely when the new state equals the current one
19	/// (`flutter_bloc`'s own `Emitter`/`Cubit.emit` short-circuit), so excluding
20	/// it would silently swallow the cubit's own re-stamp-on-status-change path
21	/// below, even though `EntryDetailScreen` itself never branches on it
22	/// (`ExpiryOverlayHost`'s own separate, pre-existing subscription is what
23	/// actually renders the overlay).
24	sealed class EntryDetailState {
25	  const EntryDetailState({this.sessionStatus});
26	
27	  final SessionStatus? sessionStatus;
28	}
29	
30	/// The one `EntriesRepository.getById` fetch is in flight — `EntryDetail
31	/// Screen` renders nothing below this (no skeleton of its own; this
32	/// screen has no prototype precedent to match, Intent).
33	class EntryDetailLoading extends EntryDetailState {
34	  const EntryDetailLoading({super.sessionStatus});
35	
36	  @override
37	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
38	      identical(this, other) ||
39	      (other is EntryDetailLoading && other.sessionStatus == sessionStatus);
40	
41	  @override
42	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(runtimeType, sessionStatus);
43	}
44	
45	/// The fetch resolved to a real [Entry] — [badgeState] is always
46	/// [SyncBadgeState.synchronized] in practice (Boundaries: "a fetched Entry
47	/// is always server-confirmed"), still derived through the one shared
48	/// `deriveSyncBadgeState()` rather than hardcoded here (Never: "a second
49	/// sync-badge derivation path").
50	class EntryDetailData extends EntryDetailState {
51	  const EntryDetailData({
52	    required this.entry,
53	    required this.badgeState,
54	    super.sessionStatus,
55	  });
56	
57	  final Entry entry;
58	  final SyncBadgeState badgeState;
59	
60	  @override
61	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
62	      identical(this, other) ||
63	      (other is EntryDetailData &&
64	          other.entry == entry &&
65	          other.badgeState == badgeState &&
66	          other.sessionStatus == sessionStatus);
67	
68	  @override
69	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(entry, badgeState, sessionStatus);
70	
71	  @override
72	  String toString() =>
73	      'EntryDetailData(entry: ${entry.id}, badgeState: $badgeState, '
74	      'sessionStatus: $sessionStatus)';
75	}
76	
77	/// `Failure.notFound` specifically — an id that never existed or belongs
78	/// to another user (RNF04). Kept as its own sealed variant purely so a
79	/// test can assert exactly which `Failure` produced a given outcome;
80	/// `EntryDetailScreen` renders this identically to [EntryDetailError]
81	/// (RNF04's "never a distinguishable permission-denied state" extends
82	/// here to "never a distinguishable failure-reason state" either, Code
83	/// Map) — the two variants never look different on screen.
84	class EntryDetailNotFound extends EntryDetailState {
85	  const EntryDetailNotFound({super.sessionStatus});
86	
87	  @override
88	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
89	      identical(this, other) ||
90	      (other is EntryDetailNotFound && other.sessionStatus == sessionStatus);
91	
92	  @override
93	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(runtimeType, sessionStatus);
94	}
95	
96	/// Every other `Failure` this screen's fetch can surface that the
97	/// repository's own offline/timeout cache fallback doesn't absorb (e.g. a
98	/// cache-miss `networkOffline`/`networkTimeout`, or any backend code the
99	/// fallback never intercepts) — Boundaries: "`Failure.notFound` (and any
100	/// other failure the cache doesn't absorb) renders one generic not-found
101	/// treatment". [message] is [Failure.message] verbatim (same convention
102	/// `MeusRegistrosError.message` already uses) but is never actually
103	/// surfaced as screen copy — kept only for this state's own equality/
104	/// toString and tests.
105	class EntryDetailError extends EntryDetailState {
106	  const EntryDetailError({required this.message, super.sessionStatus});
107	
108	  final String message;
109	
110	  @override
111	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
112	      identical(this, other) ||
113	      (other is EntryDetailError &&
114	          other.message == message &&
115	          other.sessionStatus == sessionStatus);
116	
117	  @override
118	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(message, sessionStatus);
119	
120	  @override
121	  String toString() =>
122	      'EntryDetailError(message: $message, sessionStatus: $sessionStatus)';
123	}

1	/// `POST /entries`'s four possible origins (`openapi.yaml:345-351`). This
2	/// story only ever produces [manual] (Boundaries: "source=manual for this
3	/// story") — the other three exist here already so the port
4	/// ([EntriesRepository.create]) doesn't need to change shape when Stories
5	/// 3.2/3.3 (audio/photo) and RF10 (chat) start passing them.
6	enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }
7	
8	/// A saved journal entry — plain `{id, content, source, chatMessageId,
9	/// occurredAt, serverRevision, createdAt, updatedAt, mediaDurationSeconds}`
10	/// class, no `freezed` (mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`: this feature has no
11	/// need for the union/copyWith machinery `Failure` uses). Boundaries:
12	/// never a field beyond this exact set — `tags`/`piiStatus`/`piiSpans`/
13	/// `embeddingStatus` still belong to later epics, not this story.
14	/// [mediaDurationSeconds] was the one field Story 3.1 deferred (its own
15	/// comment named it "later epics") — spec-3-2 is that story, for the
16	/// `source: audio` entries it produces.
17	///
18	/// [occurredAt]/[createdAt]/[updatedAt] are kept as the backend's own ISO
19	/// 8601 strings rather than parsed into `DateTime` on this entity itself —
20	/// spec-4-1's `groupEntriesByDate()`/`EntryRecordCard`'s own time label
21	/// each parse [occurredAt] at their own call site instead, so a malformed
22	/// string only ever risks throwing at the one place that actually needs
23	/// the parsed value, never here.
24	class Entry {
25	  const Entry({
26	    required this.id,
27	    required this.content,
28	    required this.source,
29	    required this.chatMessageId,
30	    required this.occurredAt,
31	    required this.serverRevision,
32	    required this.createdAt,
33	    required this.updatedAt,
34	    this.mediaDurationSeconds,
35	  });
36	
37	  final String id;
38	  final String content;
39	  final EntrySource source;
40	
41	  /// Non-null only for a [EntrySource.chat]-sourced entry (RF10) — always
42	  /// `null` for this story's [EntrySource.manual] entries.
43	  final String? chatMessageId;
44	  final String occurredAt;
45	  final int serverRevision;
46	  final String createdAt;
47	  final String updatedAt;
48	
49	  /// Non-null only for an [EntrySource.audio]-sourced entry
50	  /// (`AudioEntryCubit.save()`) — `null` for every other source.
51	  final int? mediaDurationSeconds;
52	
53	  @override
54	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
55	      identical(this, other) ||
56	      (other is Entry &&
57	          other.id == id &&
58	          other.content == content &&
59	          other.source == source &&
60	          other.chatMessageId == chatMessageId &&
61	          other.occurredAt == occurredAt &&
62	          other.serverRevision == serverRevision &&
63	          other.createdAt == createdAt &&
64	          other.updatedAt == updatedAt &&
65	          other.mediaDurationSeconds == mediaDurationSeconds);
66	
67	  @override
68	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
69	    id,
70	    content,
71	    source,
72	    chatMessageId,
73	    occurredAt,
74	    serverRevision,
75	    createdAt,
76	    updatedAt,
77	    mediaDurationSeconds,
78	  );
79	
80	  @override
81	  String toString() =>
82	      'Entry(id: $id, content: $content, source: $source, '
83	      'chatMessageId: $chatMessageId, occurredAt: $occurredAt, '
84	      'serverRevision: $serverRevision, createdAt: $createdAt, '
85	      'updatedAt: $updatedAt, '
86	      'mediaDurationSeconds: $mediaDurationSeconds)';
87	}

input.message:
Implemented spec-5-1 (Semantic Search with Debounced Input) in full. Frontmatter `context:` was empty, so I derived patterns directly from the Code Map's named files.

## Changes

**Domain/data (port + impl):**
- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` — added `Future<Either<Failure, List<Entry>>> search(String query)`; rewrote the stale "third and last method ... forever" doc on `getById` to acknowledge the new 4th method without contradicting AD-11.
- `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` — added `search()`: `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})`, decodes `json['data']` via the existing `EntryDto.fromJson` (list-shaped response, no `limit`/`cursor`).
- `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` — added `search()`: on success, `putAll`s every entry to the `entries` Hive box then returns `Right`; on any `Failure` (including `networkOffline`), returns `Left` unmapped — no offline/timeout cache fallback, per AD-9.

**New presentation layer:**
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) — `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`. `onQueryChanged(raw)` cancels the pending `Timer`, trims, and either emits `ResourceIdle` immediately (bumping `_generation` so an in-flight stale call is discarded too) or restarts a 300ms debounce `Timer` → `ResourceLoading` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` guard (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`) discards stale results.
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) — paper-elevated bar (`colorSurfaceElevated`/`radiusMd`/`elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing 44pt `Icons.filter_list` no-op button, no submit affordance — `onChanged` feeds the cubit directly.

**Screen wiring:**
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` — `MeusRegistrosScreen` now takes a required `searchCubit`; docks `EntriesSearchBar` above the list; a `BlocConsumer<EntriesSearchCubit, Resource<List<Entry>>>` renders the pre-existing timeline only on `ResourceIdle`, otherwise renders a new `_SearchResults` surface (own 300ms skeleton timer mirroring `_skeletonTimer`, a flat `EntryRecordCard` list with `SyncBadgeState.synchronized()` — search results are always server-confirmed, so no `deriveSyncBadgeState()` recomputation — plus minimal empty/error states).

**DI + bootstrap:**
- `entries_injection.dart` registers `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`), mirroring `MeusRegistrosCubit`.
- `app_router.dart` passes `sl<EntriesSearchCubit>()` into the route.
- `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` asserts it resolves.

**Test-suite ripple (every `implements EntriesRepository` fake needed a `search()` override since it's a new abstract method):** updated fakes in `entries_repository_impl_test.dart`, `entries_remote_data_source_test.dart` (new `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search` group), `meus_registros_cubit_test.dart`, `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`, `entry_detail_screen_test.dart`, `app_router_test.dart` (also registered a trivial `EntriesSearchCubit` into `sl` there), `pending_entry_write_tracker_test.dart`. Updated all 6 `MeusRegistrosScreen(cubit: ...)` construction sites in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` to also pass `searchCubit`, plus added a `spec-5-1: docked search bar` test group there (bar renders; typing shows results in place of the timeline; clearing reverts; offline failure renders its message).

**New tests:**
- `test/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit_test.dart` — every I/O-matrix row: semantic-match shape, rapid-typing coalescing to one call, query-cleared/no-request, offline → `ResourceError`, stale-response discarding (both "query B supersedes A" and "cleared while A in-flight"), close()-while-in-flight safety. No `bloc_test` — this stack deliberately doesn't pin it (per `auth_cubit_test.dart`'s own doc), so I used the same `cubit.stream.listen` collection helper that file documents.
- `test/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar_test.dart` — hint text, funnel icon present/no `Icons.search`, `onChanged` wired with raw (untrimmed) text, no `onSubmitted`, funnel tap is a no-op.
- `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) — happy path (real `entries-search` GET with `{q: ...}`, persists to real Hive box) + offline (genuinely retries `maxRetries` times via the real `RetryInterceptor`, then `Left` unmapped, pre-existing cache untouched) — driven directly against `sl<EntriesRepository>().search()`, same tier/rationale `entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart` used for `getById`.

## Verification
- `fvm flutter pub get` — resolved clean.
- `fvm flutter analyze` — **No issues found!**
- `fvm flutter test` — **All 752 tests passed**, exit code 0 (ran full suite, then re-ran every new/touched file individually to confirm, including the new e2e file standalone).
- No `build_runner` run needed — no `@freezed`/`@JsonSerializable` models changed.

## Known limitation (flagged, not fixed — out of spec's stated scope)
`EntriesSearchCubit` is a `lazySingleton` per the spec's explicit instruction, but `EntriesSearchBar`'s `TextField` has no controller tied to it. If a user searches, leaves "Meus Registros", and re-enters, the cubit's `Resource` state survives (e.g. still `ResourceData`) and the search-results view renders again, but the text field itself renders empty (fresh `StatefulWidget`). This mirrors exactly what the Boundaries/Code Map specify ("mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s lazySingleton") and the I/O matrix never exercises re-entry, so I implemented it as specified rather than inventing an unspecified controller/seed mechanism — worth a look if this UX gap matters to the product owner.

Files touched are listed above by path; nothing under `docs/input/` or the backend was touched, and no visual value was hardcoded outside `design_tokens.dart`.

message.content:
The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
Three review layers (blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap) ran against your spec-5-1 diff. Verification-gap found nothing. The other two surfaced several findings; after triage, four are confirmed real, trivially-fixable patches (everything else was rejected as noise or deferred as out-of-scope). Please apply all four now, re-running `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test` afterward to confirm nothing regressed, then report back.

1. `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` — `onQueryChanged`'s empty-query branch (`if (query.isEmpty) { _generation++; emit(const ResourceIdle()); return; }`) emits with no `isClosed` guard, unlike `_search()`'s own `if (isClosed || generation != _generation) return;` check right before its emit. If `onQueryChanged('')` fires after `close()` (e.g. a fast app teardown racing a keystroke), `emit()` throws `StateError`. Fix: add an `isClosed` check before that `emit(const ResourceIdle())`, mirroring `_search()`'s guard.

2. Same file — `_search()` does `emit(const ResourceLoading());`. Because `ResourceLoading<T>` has no custom `==`/`hashCode` (identity-based default) and `const ResourceLoading()` is a canonicalized singleton instance, `Cubit.emit` (package:bloc) skips re-emitting a state that's `==` to the current state. Concretely: user types "an" → debounce fires → `emit(const ResourceLoading())` (state changes from idle, listener fires, `MeusRegistrosScreen._onSearchStateChanged` arms the 300ms skeleton timer). While "an" is still in flight, user types more → "ans" debounce fires 300ms later → `_search("ans")` calls `emit(const ResourceLoading())` again, but cubit.state is *already* the same canonical `ResourceLoading` instance → `Cubit.emit` silently no-ops → `BlocConsumer`'s listener never re-fires for "ans" → the skeleton timer isn't reset for the second query, so RNF01's "no loading UI below 300ms" guarantee is measured from the wrong (stale, possibly already-elapsed) start time. Fix: change `emit(const ResourceLoading());` to `emit(ResourceLoading());` (drop `const` so each transition into loading is a fresh, non-canonicalized, identity-distinct instance that always triggers emit/listener). Leave the `ResourceIdle()`/`ResourceError`/`ResourceData` emissions as-is — they don't have this problem (`ResourceError`/`ResourceData` are already non-const with real field data; `ResourceIdle` repeating is harmless since nothing needs to re-trigger from idle-to-idle).

3. `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` — `search()` maps every returned `EntryDto` straight through with no de-duplication by id, unlike this codebase's own established defensive convention (`_dedupedById` in `meus_registros_cubit.dart`) for trusting-but-verifying server data. If the backend ever violated its own no-duplicate-ids invariant, `putAll` would silently collapse the duplicate in the Hive box while the returned `List<Entry>` still has both — and the UI's `ListView.builder` keys each card by `ValueKey(entry.id)`, so Flutter would throw a duplicate-key framework error rendering the results list. Fix: dedupe `dtos` by id (first-occurrence-wins, same semantics as `_dedupedById`) before both the `putAll` map-building and the `dtos.map(_toEntry).toList()` return, so the persisted box and the returned list are guaranteed consistent and duplicate-free.

4. `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` — the trailing funnel `IconButton` (`Icons.filter_list`) has no `tooltip`/semantic label. A screen-reader user gets an unlabeled icon button with no indication of purpose, which this codebase's own UX-DR21 ("screen-reader labels announce transitions, not just static state") and general accessibility conventions call for. Fix: add `tooltip: 'Filtros'` to the `IconButton`.

After applying, re-run `fvm flutter analyze` (expect zero issues) and `fvm flutter test` (expect all passing, including the existing `entries_search_cubit_test.dart` "Rapid typing"/skeleton-timing tests — #2's fix should make the skeleton-timer behavior actually correct under back-to-back searches, so consider whether that test file needs a new assertion covering two back-to-back in-flight searches, but only add one if you can do it without inventing new scope). Report back what you changed and the verification output.

Address this before completing your current task.

Applied all four review fixes to the spec-5-1 diff, re-verified clean.

## Fixes applied

1. **`entries_search_cubit.dart` — `isClosed` guard on the empty-query path.** `onQueryChanged`'s `if (query.isEmpty) { ... }` branch now checks `isClosed` before `emit(const ResourceIdle())` (after bumping `_generation`), mirroring `_search()`'s own `if (isClosed || generation != _generation) return;` guard. Prevents a `StateError` if a keystroke clearing the field races `close()`.

2. **Same file — dropped `const` on the loading emission.** `emit(const ResourceLoading());` → `emit(ResourceLoading());` in `_search()`. `ResourceLoading<T>` has no custom `==`, so the `const` form was a canonicalized singleton; `Cubit.emit` skips re-emitting a state `==` the current one, so a second back-to-back in-flight search's own transition into loading was silently swallowed — `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s skeleton-timer listener never re-armed for the second query. A fresh (non-const) instance is identity-distinct, so each transition now always emits.

3. **`entries_repository_impl.dart` — de-dupe `search()`'s `EntryDto` list by id.** Added a private `_dedupedById(List<EntryDto>)` (first-occurrence-wins, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._dedupedById`'s semantics) and applied it to `dtos` before both the `putAll` box write and the `.map(_toEntry).toList()` return, so the persisted box and the returned list can never disagree, and `_SearchResults`' `ValueKey(entry.id)`-keyed `ListView.builder` can never see a duplicate key even if the backend ever violated its own invariant.

4. **`entries_search_bar.dart` — added `tooltip: 'Filtros'`** to the trailing funnel `IconButton` for screen-reader accessibility.

## Test updates
- Fixed 5 pre-existing assertions in `entries_search_cubit_test.dart` that compared `cubit.state`/stream emissions against `const ResourceLoading<List<Entry>>()` by equality — now broken by fix #2's intentional move away from canonicalized instances (identity-based `==` means two separately-constructed `ResourceLoading`s are never `==`). Switched all of them to `isA<ResourceLoading<List<Entry>>>()`.
- Added a new regression test ("two back-to-back in-flight searches each emit their own distinct ResourceLoading on the stream") that asserts `emitted.whereType<ResourceLoading<List<Entry>>>()` has length 2 for a query-A-then-query-B-both-in-flight sequence — this is the one that would have caught fix #2's bug (the pre-existing "Stale response" test only checked final `cubit.state` value, which stays correct either way; it never checked whether the stream listener actually re-fired).
- Added a dedupe regression test in `entries_repository_impl_test.dart` (`search()` with a duplicate id across two items → `putAll`/returned list both collapse to one entry per id).
- Added a tooltip assertion in `entries_search_bar_test.dart`.

## Verification
- `fvm flutter analyze` — **No issues found!**
- `fvm flutter test` (full suite) — **All 757 tests passed**, exit code 0 (752 before + 5 new/added assertions across the three touched test files).
- Re-ran the three directly-touched test files in isolation (`entries_search_cubit_test.dart`, `entries_repository_impl_test.dart`, `entries_search_bar_test.dart`) — 44/44 passed, confirming each fix's own regression coverage actually exercises the bug it fixes.

Nothing else was touched; no new scope beyond the four findings plus their minimal regression coverage.

3. **`entries_repository_impl.dart` — de-dupe `search()`'s `EntryDto` list by id.** Added a private `_dedupedById(List<EntryDto>)` (first-occurrence-wins, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._dedupedById`'s semantics) and applied it to `dtos` before both the `putAll` box write and the `.map(_toEntry).toList()` return, so the persisted box and the returned list can never disagree, and `_SearchResults`' `ValueKey(entry.id)`-keyed `ListView.builder` can never see a duplicate key even if the backend ever violated its own invariant.

4. **`entries_search_bar.dart` — added `tooltip: 'Filtros'`** to the trailing funnel `IconButton` for screen-reader accessibility.
